text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's hidden, so I need her to play quiet and let me take the heat.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, tomorrow I push Sol hard, you act like a helpful citizen and back me.

name: Terra
text: No public reads yet; I protect myself.

name: Gemma
text: i can do that, just keep your head down.

name: Gemma
text: got it.

name: Sonnet
text: I already know Haiku's dirty, so I should check someone else to find the hidden killer.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm the officer; Haiku is a confirmed killer, the other killer is still hidden.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

name: Haiku

name: Haiku
text: Sol, I leaned you on a hunch. Gemma's "too easy" still bugs me more.
